reviews.comment: Wore the Rajlakshmi Temple Haar for my brother's wedding ceremony. The weight, antique matte gold luster, and carving were indistinguishable from ancestral gold jewellery. Received endless compliments!
The emerald cabochons and polki stones have such incredible depth. Delivery was seamless within 48 hours to NCR with insured packing and luxury keepsake boxes.

Ordered through the WhatsApp boutique line. The team was extraordinarily attentive, shared detailed videos under natural lighting, and guided me on neckline pairing. A true luxury boutique experience.
The side screw mechanism is so smooth and solid. The peacock engravings are razor-sharp. Best artificial jewellery craftsmanship I have encountered.

policies.noRefund: All sales at Anjali Jewels are strictly final. We adhere to a strict NO REFUND policy across all artificial jewellery collections once an order is placed and confirmed.
policies.noExchange: We enforce a strict NO EXCHANGE policy. Every single necklace, choker, bangle, and jhumka undergoes multi-stage manual quality inspection before packaging.
policies.noCod: We do NOT offer Cash on Delivery (NO COD). All orders are securely pre-paid via verified UPI, Net Banking, or Card prior to dispatch.
policies.shipping: Orders are dispatched within 24 to 48 hours via insured express courier partners across India with live SMS/WhatsApp tracking.
